items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yes, in Berlin. Gildo Mahones, who played piano, beautiful person.

ctx.x: wonderful to work with. We had a great time, the only great time I’ve had in Germany. That was the best time.
Yes, in Berlin. Gildo Mahones, who played piano, beautiful person. And Carmen, who had been married to Klook, and then she married Ike Isaacs.
